pages.text: $(2)Workflow$()$(br)1. Edit the config$(br)2. Save (keep valid JSON)$(br)3. Run $(6)/damageoverhaul reload$()$(br)4. Command feedback lists migrations and new entries$(br2)$(o)No restart ever needed.$()

$(2)Migration & Backups$()$(br)Schema version is checked every load: old formats migrate automatically, missing entries regenerate, and originals are backed up to $(n)config/damageoverhaul/backups/<timestamp>/$() before any write. All changes are logged.$(br2)$(o)Your manual edits are never overwritten.$()
